facts.fact: The article states that after the Diamniadio National Datacenter opened in June 2021, President Macky Sall instructed his government to migrate all state data and digital platforms to it and to repatriate all national data hosted outside Senegal, and that Senegal requires servers to be housed within its borders; the author cites secondary sources and gives no legal instrument.
facts.system: Presidential instruction to host state data in the Diamniadio National Datacenter

note: Operator press release mentions regulatory data localisation requirements in general terms only; no rule, instrument or enforcer is identified.

facts.fact: Law No. 25/2026, passed unanimously by the National Assembly on 20 August 2026, establishes the principle that state data must be hosted on national territory, in public facilities or with approved private providers, with possible exceptions, per Vie-publique.sn's summary as reported by Socialnetlink.
facts.system: Law No. 25/2026 on the protection of critical information infrastructure and digital security
